description: This file contains unit tests for the ThingCommandEnforcement class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies enforcement logic for access control, policy compliance, and command handling in the context of things and policies, using Akka actors and mocks.

classes.name: ThingCommandEnforcementTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing enforcement of commands within the Eclipse Ditto project, especially focusing on access control and policy compliance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem and mock actors before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests are executed.

methods.name: rejectByAcl
methods.description: Tests enforcement rejection when ACL permissions do not grant access.

methods.name: rejectByPolicy
methods.description: Tests enforcement rejection when policies do not authorize the command.

methods.name: rejectQueryByThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Tests rejection when a Thing is not accessible due to exceptions.

methods.name: rejectUpdateByThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Tests rejection on update commands when the Thing is not accessible.

methods.name: rejectQueryByPolicyNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Tests rejection when policy access is not granted.

methods.name: rejectUpdateByPolicyNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Tests rejection when policy is not accessible for modifications.

methods.name: rejectCreateByOwnAcl
methods.description: Tests rejection of create commands when the ACL restricts creation.

methods.name: rejectCreateByOwnPolicy
methods.description: Tests rejection of create commands when the specified policy is not accessible.

methods.name: acceptByAcl
methods.description: Verifies acceptance when ACL permissions allow the command.

methods.name: acceptByPolicy
methods.description: Verifies acceptance when policy permits the command.

methods.name: acceptByPolicyWithRevokeOnAttribute
methods.description: Tests acceptance with policies that revoke permissions on specific attributes.

methods.name: acceptCreateByOwnAcl
methods.description: Verifies creation acceptance when ACL permits.

methods.name: acceptCreateByInlinePolicy
methods.description: Verifies creation when an inline policy authorizes the action.

methods.name: acceptCreateByImplicitPolicyAndInvalidateCache
methods.description: Tests creation with implicit policies and cache invalidation.

methods.name: testParallelEnforcementTaskScheduling
methods.description: Tests concurrent enforcement and command scheduling behavior.

methods.name: acceptCreateByInlinePolicyWithDifferentId
methods.description: Verifies creation with inline policies having different IDs.

methods.name: testCreateByCopyFromPolicyWithAllowPolicyLockout
methods.description: Tests creation with policy lockout enabled.

methods.name: testCreateByCopyFromPolicyWithPolicyLockout
methods.description: Tests creation when policy lockout is active, expecting rejection.

methods.name: testCreateByCopyFromPolicy
methods.description: Helper method for testing creation with policies and different lockout settings.

methods.name: rejectCreateByInvalidPolicy
methods.description: Tests rejection when the policy JSON is invalid.

methods.name: rejectCreateByInvalidPolicy
methods.description: Tests rejection for invalid policy JSON during creation.

methods.name: transformModifyThingToCreateThing
methods.description: Tests transformation of modify command into create command for non-accessible things.
